svg.title: A pattern whose lines repeat, with a bar 2 block that plays in bar 2 only
svg.text: Name the bar where something happens
Every line in a pattern repeats. What’s in bar 2 { } plays in bar 2 only.
each at its own length, in every bar
A length in front of rest stands for a run of
rests, and commas separate a line’s parts.
Lower lines win where both hit the same drum.
The pattern is 2 bars: long enough to have the bar it names.
